facts.fact: Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office, headed by National Director Baker Birikujja, co-organised the NGO conference of 23 October 2026 and reminded organisations that protecting personal information is a fundamental obligation, New Vision reports.
Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office, led by a National Director, took part in the NGO compliance conference of 23 October 2026, per New Vision.
At the 23 October 2026 conference a law firm partner listed enforcement of data protection legislation among the obligations NGOs in Uganda must attend to, New Vision reports.

UGA.note: Online NGO registration and payment at the National Bureau for NGOs is expected by the end of the financial year; resources are allocated but no portal is launched or piloted.
